UniversesScreen.description: A universe is a normalized fandom: every fandom of every site is bound to one, at first to the universe of its name. A work with a fandom on its site gets its universe by itself, nothing to confirm; a site's mistake you put right on the work. Universes that are really one you merge on its card; there you also put one under another, bind it to Wikidata and have its characters read.
